name: Milcah
overview: Milcah is presented in Scripture primarily as the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and the mother of several children including Bethuel, who fathered Rebekah, a key figure in God's covenantal lineage (Genesis 11:29; 22:20-23; 24:15). The genealogical details highlight her role in the family line through which God's promises to Abraham continue. Additionally, there is mention of a Milcah who is a daughter of Zelophehad, associated with special inheritance legislation, indicating her significance in Israelite law and family structure.
